facts.fact: 两人骑马到市中心的女装布料铺「Rosalyn's Emporium」（Darragh 一到、街上的 seraph 纷纷散开）；店主 Rosalyn 铜红卷发亮绿眼、娇小——是"我"见到的第一个与"我"身量相近的 seraph 女。
facts.anchor: A tinkling of bells announced our arrival, and a pretty seraph with copper red waves and bright green eyes rounded a giant spool of plum-colored silk to greet us. She was petite, the first seraph I had seen that was of a stature more my own.

facts.fact: Darragh 向 Ros 介绍「Lady Aurora」、"我"打断纠正「叫我 Rory」，并报出需求：正式与非正式裙装、骑马穿的衣物，以及长靴、合身马裤与束腰上衣。
facts.anchor: “She needs some dresses, both formal and informal,” he said. “Maybe some she can wear while riding. And some boots with proper riding trousers and tunics.”

facts.fact: Ros 大笑说喜欢"我"——不像其他贵族那样傲慢；接着呵斥 Darragh 别在门口阴沉吓客，这位全城最危险的 seraph 乖乖坐进店角的薰衣草色天鹅绒椅。
facts.anchor: Rosalyn smiled widely. “Oh, I like her, Darragh. She’s not uppity like the rest of the nobles.”

facts.fact: 一小时后"我"购得 10 条新裙、3 套束腰上衣配骑马裤、1 双骑马靴、晚宴手套与 4 双拖鞋；Ros 将按尺寸修改、一两天内把成品送到城堡。
facts.anchor: By the end of an hour, I had ten new dresses, three tunics and riding pants, a pair of riding boots, evening gloves, and four pairs of slippers.

facts.fact: "我"想带女儿 Cora 来做衣服；Ros 说店里没有幼童试穿样衣（贵族幼童凤毛麟角），但可以替"我"的小家伙赶做几条裙、叫"我"带她来。
facts.anchor: “I don’t have any samples for younglings to try on, as noble younglings are far and few between,” she said easily. “But I can certainly whip up a few dresses for your little one. Bring her by.”

facts.fact: 出店前 Rosalyn 悄悄塞给 Darragh 一张纸条，两人对视片刻才各自走开（纸条内容未说明）；她随后嚷着「下次回来把 Rory 一起带上」。
facts.anchor: Darragh moved like lightning to the door while trying to dodge anything frilly or laced. Before we could step out, Rosalyn cornered Darragh and silently handed him a slip of paper. They made eye contact, let it linger for a moment, and then stepped away from each other.

facts.fact: 在户外面包摊"我"点了 2 个肉桂司康、2 个苹果肉桂手派、1 个蜂蜜蛋糕、5 个奶油酥点，要求蜂蜜蛋糕与奶油酥点分开装、记在王室账上——甜点是给爱吃肉桂的女儿 Cora 买的。
facts.anchor: “Can I have two of the scones, two of the pies, a honey cake, and five of the cream pastries? Box up the honey cake and the pastries separately if you can. Can you put it on the tab of the crown?”

facts.fact: "我"端着奶油酥点穿过街，把整盒送给对面一群衣衫褴褛的 daemonite 幼童（最大的女孩不过七八岁）让他们分享；孩子们愣了一下便拆盒抢食大吃——Darragh 后来说「你大概让他们高兴了一整月」。
facts.anchor: I approached the oldest child, who couldn’t be more than seven or eight, and handed her the box of cream pastries. “These are for you to share. Enjoy!” The younglings stared at me for a moment and then practically ripped open the box, each grabbing a pastry and shoveling it into their mouths.

facts.fact: "我"把系着白绿面包棉绳的蜂蜜蛋糕盒递给 Darragh——他慢慢接过、连眨两次眼，迟疑得像在防一个圈套；"我"伸手要收回时他立刻把盒子拉近怀里并生硬道谢，仍称"我" my lady（"我"再次要求他叫 Rory）。
facts.anchor: “Oh, don’t worry. You get something, too.” I held out a box tied with white and green baker’s twine from my stack. He slowly took it from my hands and blinked twice. His hesitation lingered, like what I was offering was a trick.
